name: The Masked Figure
bio: Nobody has seen his face. Nobody wants to.
notes: Drive intake of 2026-11-05 ("The Masked Figure", rigged and animated on Meshy (Mixamo joint names read as Meshy's; finger chains, where it has them, folded into the hands and refitted by hands.mjs; its clips not used)). A man in a sack mask, a stained work shirt and trousers (Undead & Horror). Standard size. Rigged in an A-pose. Display name a placeholder for the owner. Licence recorded as owned (no metadata says otherwise); the owner to confirm, and if it is a Meshy community model, switch to CC0 with its author and post URL.

source.author: the owner, on their Meshy subscription
